_note: The DECLARED engine capabilities. Factual coverage can be complete while the engine is still unable to use the facts, so capabilities are units of the universe with their own owners. A capability whose owner is null is reported UNOWNED by the closed-world guard — never silently omitted.

_owner_kinds.positive_owner: a test proving the capability works
_owner_kinds.negative_owner: a test proving the capability does NOT fire where it must not
_owner_kinds.mutation_owner: a mutation that removes the capability and is proven to go RED for its own semantic reason

capabilities._why: The engine's most safety-critical behaviour was not a declared capability at all. Every other capability here is about being RIGHT; this one is about refusing to act, and it was the one left undeclared.

_conversational_note: A capability flagged `conversational` is a claim about turn N resolving against turn N-1. It cannot be demonstrated by a single question, so the closed-world guard requires at least one multi-turn journey to exercise it in production — unit-test ownership alone leaves the behaviour unproven on the deployed system.
